delete.description:
Second-level soft-delete of a delivery payment that has already been removed. The row is
retained for recoverability but excluded from every read path (active table, totals,
reports, folios). Requires the payment to be removed first. Restricted to Admins/Managers
and above via RBAC.
delete.summary: Delete a removed delivery payment from a commission invoice

patch.description:
Edits an offline delivery payment (Cash/Check/Bad Debts). Only paymentDate, amount, and remarks
are editable; invoice date, cheque number, payment method, and receipt number are not. Editing
the amount recomputes the invoice delivered/due totals and settlement status. Editing the date
follows the offline backdating rules (audit setting + invoice creation date). All fields are
optional; a nil field is left unchanged. A removed or deleted payment cannot be edited.
patch.summary: Edit a delivery payment on a commission invoice

post.description:
First-level soft-removes a delivery payment: the row is dropped from the active payment table
but retained for audit logs, folios, and reports. The invoice delivered/due totals and
settlement status are reverted. No automated refund is performed for any payment method;
any required refund is handled offline.
post.summary: Remove a delivery payment from a commission invoice

sourceEnquiryId.description: SourceEnquiryID is the UUID the service generates immediately before storing the business source enquiry in Redis (POST .../business-source-enquiry/:id). It matches JSON businessSourceEnquiryId and maps this row to that cache entry / pre-store id.

dnrIds.description: Reservation-scoped DNR IDs (tracks which DNRs were tagged in this reservation)

vehicleColorMakeModel.description:
VehicleColorMakeModel is the legacy single vehicle field. Retained for
backward compatibility with historic reservations; new reservations use the
split VehicleMake/VehicleModel/VehicleColor fields below.

crsTranId.description: CRS (Central Reservation System) — set when reservation is created from CRS payload

isHourly.description:
Hourly Rental (phase 3): true = hourly (walk-in, single-room, same/next-day) reservation.
All pre-existing rows are Non-Hourly by default (design: "all other reservations would be Non-Hourly").

isLocked.description: No updates allowed when IsLocked flag is true

isRevenuePosted.description:
Revenue posting fields for manual no-show/cancel revenue posting
NULL = not applicable (reservation not NO_SHOW/CANCELLED yet)
false = pending manual posting
true = revenue has been posted
